title: The Cloudy sky over the field
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：cloudy　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cloudy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the ranger wrote of ① a cloudy sky over the field in the survey, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② cloudier than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the ranger, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the cloudy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the cloudiest sky over the field anybody in the valley had ever seen, or so the survey for October 1984 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too cloudy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the villager who had come to help; the cloudy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a cloudy water in the jar, and said that no villager in his right mind would call it ⑥ as cloudy as the water in the jar they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was cloudy or not, and he said so.

By 1997 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was ⑦ something cloudy, and nothing besides. The villager from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite cloudy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the survey kept the names of the cloudy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2000, at once, she wrote of another cloudy sky over the field in the same survey, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ cloudier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The cloudiest water in the jar in the whole valley, she said in 2002, was the one she could never quite name; the cloudy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 多云（前置定语 a cloudy sky over the field：1990 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的那件多云的天空）
B. adj. 多云／浑浊（比较级 cloudier than：文中两处，一处比田野上的天空，一处比预想）
C. adj. 多云／浑浊（最高级 the cloudiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 多云（表语 too cloudy to do：母亲觉得它太多云，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 浑浊（前置定语 a cloudy water in the jar：叔叔把整件事称作一桩浑浊的水）
F. adj. 浑浊（同级比较 as cloudy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩罐里的水相比）
G. adj. 浑浊（后置定语 something cloudy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 浑浊（受程度副词修饰 quite cloudy：那位村民的评价）

items.q: a cloudy sky over the field
the cloudiest sky over the field anybody
a cloudy water in the jar
The cloudiest water in the jar in

answers.why: cloudy 意为“多云”，1990 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的是“一件多云的天空”，此处作前置定语 a cloudy sky over the field。
cloudy 意为“多云”，此处用比较级 cloudier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
cloudy 意为“多云”，踏勘记录上 十月 那行字说它是山谷里最多云的一件，故用最高级 the cloudiest sky over the field。
cloudy 意为“多云”，母亲认为这件东西“太多云了，谁也用不上”，too cloudy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
cloudy 意为“浑浊”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩浑浊的水”，此处作前置定语 a cloudy water in the jar。
cloudy 意为“浑浊”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩罐里的水一样浑浊”，同级比较用 as cloudy as。
cloudy 意为“浑浊”，踏勘记录上那半行字要的是“浑浊的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something cloudy。
cloudy 意为“浑浊”，邻山谷来的那位村民认为这套计划“相当浑浊”，quite 修饰原级 cloudy。
cloudy 意为“浑浊”，2000 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要浑浊”，故用比较级 cloudier than。
cloudy 意为“浑浊”，母亲 2002 年说的是“整个山谷里最浑浊的那一桩”，故用最高级 the cloudiest water in the jar。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1990 年，守林人在踏勘记录里记下了一件多云的天空。（a cloudy sky over the field）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更多云。（cloudier than …）
母亲觉得它太多云，谁也用不上。（too cloudy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩浑浊的水。（a cloudy water in the jar）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩罐里的水一样浑浊。（as cloudy as …）
到了 1997 年，踏勘记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件浑浊的东西。（something cloudy）
answers: In 1990 the ranger wrote of a cloudy sky over the field in the survey.
Everybody said it was cloudier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too cloudy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a cloudy water in the jar.
He said nobody would call it as cloudy as the water in the jar they had once had.
By 1997 the survey asked for nothing but something cloudy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cloudy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the ranger wrote of a cloudy sky over the field in the survey, and nobody forgot it.
It was the cloudiest sky over the field in the valley, or so the survey says.
My mother thought it too cloudy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a cloudy water in the jar, and nobody argued with him.
The villager from the next valley called the plan quite cloudy, and everybody laughed.
The cloudy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
